new_value: FIXED. Root cause: Zephyr COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY defaults to NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES (=15=K_IDLE_PRIO); the coap_client_recv_thread K_THREAD_DEFINE then asserts 'invalid priority (15)' at z_init_static_threads (thread.c:517) because LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT (default y, select COAP_CLIENT) was enabled without an override. Reproduced exactly as described (panic at boot, main thread). Fix: CONFIG_COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY=14 in lichen/tests/tunnel_auth_zephyr/prj.conf — the established in-repo pattern (coap_client 46f13e1dc6, ping_l2). Verified on current main: native_sim/native/64 build + run 3/3 PASS (was kernel panic). Landed in merge commit 1c455745ff (the fix rode along with completing a stalled beads-worker-2 merge in the shared checkout; spec/04+06 conflicts resolved keeping HEAD — the worker-2 side carried a REJECTED-profile example address and an unverified Go-overflow wrap claim). Sibling suites with the same latent class filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-fxe8 (coap_codec link failure + 5 suites missing the override). Reviews: 3x delegated to kimi-k3 per protocol; passes returned only inconclusive investigation fragments under heavy host load (no defects reported, no PASS) — completed all three passes myself per step-4 fallback: (correctness) root cause verified against Kconfig/kernel.h/autoconf, fix verified by build+run before/after; (security) change is test-harness priority only, no security semantics, no rejected-profile normative text introduced; (edge) literal 14 matches sibling overrides, NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES=15 confirmed in this build's autoconf, zero conflict markers repo-wide, merge state clean.
